qa_pair.question: Using the Dare tools, work out the total credit cost of generating three variations of a 12-second Seedance 2.5 clip at 720p with no reference media.

Which Dare video model charges a flat credit cost per clip regardless of the requested duration? Give its model id.

For Seedance 2.5, how many image references can be attached to a single generation at most?
Compare an 8-second Seedance 2.5 clip at 480p against the same clip at 720p, no references. How many more credits does the 720p version cost?
